'There is already granite at home' is a household fact with existing_stone_type GRANITE and no accommodation fact_type or value. Extract established household agreements as typed household facts: decision_rotation_agreed means small decisions are taken in turns; decision_deadline_agreed means an agreed deadline for shared decisions. Use value true for an explicitly established agreement and false for an explicit denial. Absence of an agreement is unknown, never value false. A quiet home never establishes or denies either agreement. Wishes, requests, hypothetical plans, and mere stone presence do not establish an agreement. Reference the original fragment ID. For an agreement, leave existing_stone_type empty. Set applies_to_pair to the two named types when the agreement is pair-specific, including repeated types. Leave it empty only for a household-wide agreement. 'Must live well with granite' is a compatibility requirement. 'Ideally likes company' is a character preference.
